'''Kevin Brownell''' (forum handle '''CubsFan''') served as an advocate of the [[Players Committee]] for marketing and player relations.

He accepted an invitation to become the Marketing &amp; Player Relations Player Advocate in 2004. His role was to keep the community up to date on events and game news, on the official site and on other CCG websites, and to act as a liaison between the PC and the playing community. He was also named a member of the PC's &ldquo;WebGroup&rdquo;, formed at the same time to coordinate the PC website.<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref>
